cold_start.subject: Kiroshi Dev release bundle against the preview with --dev-host, on 'Bench: long conversation' (0786b59c-31fb-46ba-9b69-2446f0816409)
cold_start.launch: open -n on an app bundle on both sides (the preview through a bundle linking its release binary)
cold_start.conditions: process cold, file cache warm; Kiroshi Dev starts its own host and opens the conversation from its restored tab; the preview starts against Kiroshi Dev's host already running and finds the longest conversation itself

first_frame.tool: the pid's first layer-0 window over 10,000 pt² in CGWindowListCopyWindowInfo, polled

conversation_displayed.tool: screencapture -l of that window, recognised by Vision (fast) as holding 'Quokka', the last word of the last message; resolution: the gap to the previous capture
